Register and read the analysis dataset

pk_data.Rd

With file, the dataset is copied into the project's data/ folder (unless it is already there), registered in config.yml, and returned. Without file, the registered dataset is read. Missing values are read from the data$na entry of the config (default ".").

Usage

pk_data(file = NULL, copy = TRUE, proj = NULL)

Arguments

file

Path to a csv file. Optional after the first call.

copy

Copy the file into the project data/ folder?

proj

A pk_project object. Defaults to the current project.

Value

A data frame with attribute data_hash (md5 hash of the data).

Details

A file that is registered must contain the required columns ID, TIME, DV, EVID and AMT (the names can be changed in the data section of config.yml; names are case-sensitive). The header is checked before the file is copied or registered, so a file with missing columns is rejected and the project stays unchanged. CMT is optional. pk_run() repeats the check for the data it fits, and pk_check() reports missing columns as errors.

Examples

p <- pk_project(file.path(tempdir(), "demo_data"))
d <- pk_data(system.file("extdata", "example_pk.csv", package = "poppkflow"))
head(d)
#>   ID TIME     DV AMT EVID   WT AGE SEXF CRCL
#> 1  1 0.00     NA 100    1 83.2  27    0   71
#> 2  1 0.25 0.0514   0    0 83.2  27    0   71
#> 3  1 0.50 0.2651   0    0 83.2  27    0   71
#> 4  1 1.06 0.5431   0    0 83.2  27    0   71
#> 5  1 2.07 0.9640   0    0 83.2  27    0   71
#> 6  1 3.00 0.9350   0    0 83.2  27    0   71
